column1: # Known, explained deviations for bench/tok-gate.sh. Tab separated: KEY ARM MAX REASON.
# KEY = tokenizer fingerprint (16 hex, column 2 of the receipt), or a pre name, or (arm `unsupported`) a tokenizer.ggml.model.
# ARM = llama | hf | round | pieces | unsupported. MAX = cases that may differ (unsupported: 1).
# A line is a debt with a reason, never a tolerance: delete it and the gate enforces again.

column4: WordPiece GGUF: only llama.cpp's test vocab on disk; the bge embed path has its own embed/wordpiece.mojo on vocab.txt
Unigram GGUF: only llama.cpp's test vocab (nomic-bert-moe) on disk, no model served
llama.cpp promotes the NORMAL token `</s>` (id 128247) to CONTROL by a name list (llama-vocab.cpp "control-looking token"); ours keeps the type in the file. Cases l-specials-012, w-specials
same `</s>` promotion (ggml-vocab-qwen2)
same `</s>` promotion (qwen2.5-0.5b)
same `</s>` promotion (Qwen3 1.7B / 8B Q4_K_M)
same `</s>` promotion (Qwen3-8B Q4_0)
same `</s>` promotion (qwen2moe)
same `</s>` promotion (qwen3moe)
same `</s>` promotion (mimo-vl)
llama.cpp sets rstrip on phi-3 special tokens by model name; ours has no per-token strip attributes. Cases l-specials-016, w-specials
deepseek-coder: ours is the HF split chain, llama.cpp approximates it (serve/pretok-known-diffs.txt, 22215/22215 vs HF at 9e45d26)
the only matching tokenizer.json on disk (MAX llama3 testdata) has no `ignore_merges: true`; llama.cpp agrees with ours 75/75. Cases with ` Việt`
gemma4 writes a space as U+2581, so a literal U+2581 in the text decodes as a space (4 cases contain it)
SPM: literal U+2581 decodes as a space (llama-spm)
SPM: literal U+2581 decodes as a space (phi-3)
SPM: literal U+2581 decodes as a space (baichuan)
Qwen3 tokenizer.json normalizes to NFC (GGUF key tokenizer.ggml.normalizer.nfc); ours and llama.cpp do not normalize. Case w-long-16k (U+2126, U+212A in a regex class). OPEN: NFC not implemented
same NFC gap (Qwen3-8B Q4_0)
same NFC gap (qwen3moe)
tiny_llama test GGUF has no tokenizer.ggml.pre: ours and llama.cpp both fall back to `default` (75/75 equal), the json beside it is llama-bpe
aquila: llama.cpp promotes the NORMAL token `<|endoftext|>` to CONTROL by its name list; ours keeps the type in the file
falcon has no token for some bytes; llama.cpp and ours drop them (ids equal 75/75), so w-whitespace cannot round trip
